h1: Window cleaning in Bluffs at Flintrock
intro: Bluffs at Flintrock is an open subdivision across from Flintrock Falls that backs up to Falconhead West. CleanzATX works here with no gate to coordinate, and you deal with Tyler directly.

sections.h2: What Bluffs at Flintrock homes are like
paragraphs: Bluffs at Flintrock sits across from the entrance to Flintrock Falls, on the Lakeway and Bee Cave side of 78738. Unlike its neighbors, it has no gate and no HOA, which makes it more relaxed to get in and out of. Homes are priced from about $700K to $1.2M, so this is a more reachable way into the Flintrock area.

The subdivision backs to Falconhead West, so it sits between two established neighborhoods. Lots slope with the land, and many homes sit up on a bluff, which is where the name comes from. Without an HOA, owners decide on their own exterior upkeep, and that makes regular window and house cleaning a personal choice, not a community schedule.

Homes on bluffs get wind, and wind carries dust and pollen. Cedar pollen from December to February and live oak pollen in March and April land on the windows and stick after morning dew. Trees and brush near the edge of the subdivision bring spider webs and leaf litter to the screens and tracks. Sprinklers and hose water leave white mineral marks on the lower glass, especially on the sunny side.

Our dual RO, 4 stage pure water system with a DI resin tank gets water near 0 TDS, so glass dries with no spots and no soap film. Screens are $5 each, tracks are $5, and hard water spot removal is $10 per pane for deposits that need more than a rinse.

sections.h2: How we work Bluffs at Flintrock
paragraphs: Being open makes scheduling easy. There is no gate to clear, so you text us the address and a good day, and we pull in. We can work whether or not you are home for the outside. We carry 200 gallons of water on an 8 ft skid, so we do not use your hose. Bluffs sits close to Flintrock Falls and Falconhead West, so we often group visits across the three, and lead time is usually within two weeks. Without an HOA, there are fewer rules about what trucks can park where, but we still keep driveways clear and neat.

For a typical 3,000 sq ft home here, exterior windows come to about $300 at $0.10 per sq ft. Exterior time is about 45 to 60 minutes per 1,000 sq ft, so plan on about three hours, plus about 30 minutes per 1,000 sq ft for the inside. Minimum job is $200.

faq.q: Can you clean upper floor windows?
faq.a: Yes. Water fed poles reach up to three stories from the ground, so no ladder leans on the house for the outside glass.

faq.q: What if I notice a spot the next day?
faq.a: Text a photo within 7 days and we come back free when we are in the area. All jobs have a 100% satisfaction guarantee.
